mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and 63 degree weather near the Verona Area High School. Tonight, the International Space Station will be visible starting at 6:30 PM, moving from the south southwest over Belleville toward the east northeast over the Fitchburg and Madison area while climbing to the middle of the sky.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Mark Drive Reconstruction Project, which involves upgrades to water and sanitary sewer lines as well as new sidewalks and pavement between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue.
For entertainment this week, we have plenty of trivia options happening today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, followed by live music and yoga sessions scheduled for tomorrow.
In a report regarding local incidents, on October 23, two thirteen-year-old juveniles were stopped by police for riding prohibited eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for their parents.
If you are craving something sweet, head over to Culver's today to try the Chocolate Heath Crunch flavor of the day; they are currently open and serving until 10 PM.
